title: docs(search): make the mirror field the one prescription for related-title search
body:
Fixes #4840

Writes the maintainer-approved short-term ruling (2026-08-06 fleet decision box) into the authoring corpus: the **mirror field** is the current, only answer for "keyword-search records by a related record's title". One prescription, told the same way in every location — not three paraphrases.

Verbatim ruling being implemented:

> 「裁短期 1——镜像字段确立为「按关联记录标题搜索」的当前唯一正解,写进 skill 与文档(AI 元数据生成的高频意图给出标准答案,消除各写各的);方向 2(spec 受限关联投影 `{via, field}` + 引擎展开 JOIN)保留为未立项方向,不启动;3(扩展 __search 伴生列)同样不启动。#4254 的跨对象路径拒收闸维持不动。」

Docs/skills only. **No `packages/**` changes** — #4254's cross-object rejection gate is untouched, and routes 2/3 are not written in as roadmap. Each location carries at most one neutral sentence that cross-object search paths are rejected by design, not pending.

## Premises verified against `origin/main`

| Premise | Verdict |
|:---|:---|
| #4254 ingress gate refuses a dotted `$searchFields` path with a 400 and a dedicated hint | Confirmed — `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:4808-4813` |
| `validate-searchable-fields` refuses the same dotted path at build time | Confirmed — `searchable-field-unknown`, `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts:331-352` |
| `skills/objectstack-data` and `skills/objectstack-query` carry no cross-object-search guidance | Confirmed — the gap was real; the only prior mention anywhere in either skill was one sentence in `objectstack-query` naming `searchableFields` |

## One correctness point the existing hints get loose

The lint hint says to *"copy the value onto a **formula** field here"* / *"mirror it onto a **text/formula** field here"*. Only the **stored** half works, and the docs added here say so explicitly:

- A `formula` field is **virtual** — no driver materializes a column for it (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:568-573`, `driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts:337`, `driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts:1224`), so a `$contains` predicate against one has nothing to scan. The engine's own comment records the failure mode: *"the SQL driver emits `SELECT response_rate …` which fails as 'no such column' and the driver returns [] (silently)"*.
- CEL formulas read only this record's own fields (`record.<field>`), so a formula could not fetch the related title in the first place.
- Nothing rejects the mistake. Verified by running `resolveSearchFieldResolution` directly: a declared list is admitted verbatim, so a `formula` entry clears both lint and the #4254 gate and then just never matches.

  ```
  AUTO:          {"allowed":["name","project_name"],"source":"auto"}          // lookup + formula excluded
  DECL-FORMULA:  {"allowed":["name","project_name_formula"],"source":"declared"}  // admitted anyway
  DECL-TEXT:     {"allowed":["name","project_name"],"source":"declared"}
  ```

Correcting the hint strings themselves is a `packages/**` change and is therefore **out of scope here** — recommended as a follow-up.

## Per-location before → after

### `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (+90)
- **Before:** zero occurrences of `searchableFields`. Nothing about search anywhere in the skill.
- **After:** new `## Search Fields (searchableFields)` section between Object Capabilities and Field Groups — the canonical set and its auto-default, then `### ⛔ Searching by a related record's title — mirror the value, always` carrying the full prescription: the worked `task` → `project_name` example, the ❌ formula-field rule, the mirror-maintenance table (two write paths + backfill), and **both** error messages quoted verbatim so either one greps back to the fix.

### `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` (+51)
- **Before:** `## Full-Text Search` said only "Omit `fields` to search the object's declared `searchableFields`". No mention that `fields` can only narrow, none of the dotted-path refusal.
- **After:** the narrow-never-widen sentence, plus a `### ⛔ Searching by a related record's title — mirror the value, always` subsection with the verbatim 400, the query-side shape and its expansion, the stored-not-formula rule, and pointers to the modelling side (objectstack-data) and to the two adjacent axes (nested relation filter to *filter*, `expand` to *display*). Also a new row in **Cross-Object Queries: Which Tool to Use?**.

### `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx` (+89)
- **Before:** `### Global search — searchable + searchableFields` ended at "When `searchableFields` is unset, search falls back to the name/title field plus short-text fields."
- **After:** the canonical long form as `#### Searching by a related record's title — mirror the value` — every other touchpoint links here. Rule, worked example, `type="warn"` callout on stored-vs-formula, maintenance table, both error messages verbatim, and the stale-declaration variant of the 400.

### `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` (+24)
- **Before:** the `$searchFields` callout under `## Full-Text Search`, then straight into Pinyin recall.
- **After:** a `### Searching by a related record's title — mirror the value` section between them — verbatim 400, the short prescription, and a link to the canonical section.

### `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` (+26)
- **Before:** the search section ended at the `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` note.
- **After:** `#### Searching by a related record's title — mirror the value` before `### Joins — removed` — same short form, protocol-level phrasing (`searchFields: ['project_id.name']` is refused at the ingress).

### `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (+13)
- **Before:** the failure-matrix table listed two `searchFields` rejections; the prose named three causes.
- **After:** a fourth matrix row for `?search=alpha&searchFields=project_id.name`, and the dotted path called out in the `searchFields` bullet as the typo case with its own hint, with the prescription and the canonical link.

### `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (+2/-1)
- **Before:** `| searchableFields | string[] | optional | Fields included in search |`
- **After:** the same row spelling out that it narrows and never widens, that a lookup or dotted entry makes **every** toolbar search on the list return `400 INVALID_FIELD` (#4254), and linking to the mirror-field recipe.

## Not done, and why

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` was considered (the issue names it) but has **no** `searchableFields` coverage to attach the prescription to — its only mention is `references/react-blocks.md`, which is generated from `packages/spec` and would break `check:skill-refs`. The UI-side landing is `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` instead. Adding a search section to that skill is a separate, larger change.
